body:
Founder ran the queued nginx deploy (sudo-queue/96). Re-verifying immediately against production with a real Playwright run caught a second real, live-only bug: the SSO popup saved its exchanged session into its own sessionStorage, never the opener's (sessionStorage is scoped per top-level browsing context) -- Save to IDUNA registered a real account but then failed not signed in. Fixed by saving in the opener's own onMessage handler. Combined with IDUNA's Content-Type fix (companion Apple), the full round trip is now confirmed live: record -> stop -> sign in via popup -> save -> shows up in my mixes with a working download button. MIXFORGE@32943c7.

⚓ ☃
title: Save to IDUNA is fully live end-to-end (S513)
